⚠ Finding
No AE follow-up received
Cancelled orders left "Unscheduled" don't generate a lead or trigger any follow-up in Jordan's dashboard/flow — the record just sits with no next action assigned. Cortez (OID 253793) is the live example: cancelled Aug 25, no outreach as of this writing.
⚠ Per SOP
"Unscheduled" is a lead
Per ISN SOP, "Unscheduled" = Lead — an OID created but not scheduled. It should be followed up on like any other lead.
